Complete Plumbing Care for Jersey City Homes & Businesses

Many homes still have old metal pipes that wear down with time. Basements sit below street level, so rain and snow can push water back inside.

Hard water leaves buildup that slows drains and stains fixtures. We keep water flowing safely through brownstones, walk-ups and high-rises.

Drain & Sewer Repair & Cleaning Services

Clogged drains and sewers can slow down your whole plumbing systems and cause safety health and environment hazards.

In New Jersey, heavy rain can push water back into basements through floor drains, we clear your lines so water flows out safely and never backs up again!

High-pressure jetting to remove grease and dirt.
Camera checks to find hidden clogs.
Root removal from old underground lines.
Backwater valves and cleanouts to stop flood backups.
SCHEDULE HERE
Water Heater Repair, Installation & Replacement Services

Hot water should be ready when you need it. Whatever kind of a water heater you have, whether a tank system or a wall-mounted tankless unit, we keep it working right.

We fix leaks, restore heat and install energy-saving models that last.

All installs follow local permit rules and safe venting codes. Many new systems qualify for PSE&G and NJ Clean Energy rebates.

SCHEDULE HERE
Leak Detection & Pipe Repair Services

Leaks can start small but cause big trouble later. Most homes have old metal pipes that rust or crack behind walls. We find leaks early and fix them before they damage your home.

Here’s how we locate and repair leaks fast:

Electronic leak finding for hidden spots.
Replace rusty or lead pipes with safe new lines.
Seal weak joints and restore steady water flow.
Heating Repairs & Comfort Upgrades for Cold Jersey City Winters

Cold winds off the Hudson make steady heat important. Many older homes use steam radiators and cast-iron boilers that creak and hiss. We repair, replace and tune systems so your home feels cozy all-season.

SCHEDULE HERE
Basement Flooding Solutions with Sump Pump Services for Rainy Days

North Jersey homes often face flooding after heavy rain. Water can rise through basement drains or low-level plumbing lines. We install systems that stop water before it causes damage.

Here’s how we help your home stay dry and safe:

Install sump and ejector pumps.
Add backwater valves to stop sewer backup.
Clean and inspect drains before big storms.
Central Heating Repair, Installation & Replacement Services

We offer 24/7 emergency central heating repair, installation and replacement services in Jersey City, New Jersey.

Whether you’re looking for residential service for your home or commercial service for your business, we got you covered!

CALL NOW
Boiler & Furnace Repair, Installation & Replacement Services

When your heat goes out, every hour feels longer. We repair boilers and furnaces fast so you can stay comfortable through every cold snap. Our team checks everything carefully for safety and steady warmth.

Here’s what we inspect and repair to keep heat flowing

Fix the ignition and airflow issue.
Adjust the thermostats for even heat.
Test gas like carbon monoxide safety.
Annual Heating Tune-Ups

A small tune-up can prevent a big problem later. We clean and test your system before winter begins, so your heat turns on when you need it most. Regular care helps it run safely all season.

Here’s what we include in every tune-up

Clean burners, filters and vents.
Check airflow and pressure for steady heat.
Test carbon monoxide and similar gases safety.
Air Conditioning Services for Hot Jersey City Summers

Summer heat can make apartments feel stuffy fast. Many buildings use ductless mini-splits, PTAC units, or small central systems that need steady care.

We repair, install and replace all types of air conditioning systems, ensuring quality and quick services 24/7.

Here’s how we keep your AC running right

Fast AC repair and refrigerant checks.
Smart thermostats for easy control.
Coil cleaning and drain service for high-rises.
Our Simple 3-Step Service Process

We make every job simple and clear from start to finish.

 

Here is a proven 3-step process that we follow:

Inspect & Explain

We check your system and tell you what’s wrong in plain words.

Repair or Replace

We fix the issue or install new parts safely and quickly.

Test & Clean

We make sure everything works and leave your space tidy.

Permits, Rebates & Inspections Made Easy

Permits can feel confusing, but we handle them for you.

 

The Jersey City Construction Code oversees plumbing and HVAC work. We file through the online portal and schedule inspections so everything passes without delay.

 

We also guide you through rebates for high-efficiency boilers, furnaces and AC systems. Upgrades cost less upfront, and every install meets city code.

SCHEDULE HERE
Why Jersey City Families Trust American Way

Families choose American Way because we care about your comfort and your home. We show up on time, explain everything clearly and clean up before we leave.

Here’s why local homeowners count on us:

Licensed and insured local team.
Fair, upfront prices with no hidden fees.
Quiet, respectful work every day.
Warranty-backed repairs and installs.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
DO I NEED A PERMIT FOR A NEW WATER HEATER OR BOILER?

Yes, most new water heaters and boilers need a city permit. We handle the forms and inspections for you.

WHY DOES MY BASEMENT FLOOD WHEN IT RAINS?
WHAT HEAT MUST LANDLORDS GIVE IN WINTER?

DO YOU WORK ON TANKLESS WATER HEATERS?

Contact American Way to Keep Your Home Comfortable All-Year Long

Your home should always feel comfortable and complete. A warm shower, clean water and cool air makes every day better. When something stops working, our local team is ready to help.

We offer free estimates and same-day services all across North New Jersey. Contact us today and let’s get your home running smoothly again!

American Way Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning in Jersey City NJ

American Way Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning provides full plumbing, heating, and cooling service across Jersey City, NJ.

We handle leaks, drain and sewer issues, water heater repairs and replacements, boiler and furnace service, and AC repairs when the heat hits. Old pipes, flooded basements, no heat, no hot water, boiler noise, all of that we deal with it every day.

You call, and we’re there within the same day, figure out what’s wrong, and take care of it with clear pricing. Whether it’s an emergency or something you’ve been meaning to fix since long, we keep your home running the way it should all-year round!
